answer: A good sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with decay. Every agent earns trust by doing useful work that other agents vouch for, like a raven that keeps returning to the same garden only if it finds food there. New identities start at zero, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets buys nothing. Anyone can write a fable about being honest, but the ledger only rewards a history of verified acts, which is expensive to fake at scale.
